items.text: v1 (reachable blocker: restockReport still uses < while restockNeeded is fixed to <=) produces a blocker finding and verdict BLOCK.
v2 (only should-fix findings: swallowed writer error, untested error path) produces verdict FIX-THEN-COMMIT — not BLOCK, not CLEAR.
v3 (only nit-level observations possible) keeps nits advisory; nits never become an implicit merge veto and the verdict is not escalated by them.
v7 (pre-existing legacy test failure, docs-only diff) does not fabricate the failure as a diff finding; attribution is pre-existing.
v5 (diff-caused test failure) surfaces the gate failure as diff-caused and blocks readiness on it.
v6 (env-gated skip) reports verification as inconclusive for the new mechanism — not as pass, not as fabricated failure.
v4 (clean, tested feature) produces CLEAR with no fabricated findings; what-holds-up evidence is present.
